architects:loader-monteith.name: Loader Monteith
paragraphs: Loader Monteith is an architecture practice in Glasgow, Scotland, founded in 2016 by Matt Loader and Iain Monteith. It designs new houses and works on existing and historic buildings, with an approach built around conservation, heritage work and circular design: reusing materials, recycling construction waste and designing buildings that can be taken apart.

On Formground its work is shown through {count} houses across Scotland, from new family homes on farms and hillsides to extensions of listed and conservation-area cottages and townhouses. Each house links to its project page on the practice's own site.
facts: Houses: new builds, extensions and conservation

edit.standfirst: A Glasgow practice, founded in 2016, working on new houses and on conservation and heritage buildings.

makers:byarums-bruk.name: Byarums Bruk
paragraphs: Byarums Bruk is a foundry and furniture maker in Byarum, Småland, Sweden, founded in 1947 by the Bokinge brothers. At a time when cast iron dominated, they chose to cast aluminium. In 1974 the second owner, Hans Pruth, took over with a vision of making furniture, and from the 1980s the company began developing its own models with the designer Björn Alge.

Today the range is mainly outdoor and public-space furniture: benches, tables, armchairs and sofas, plus planters, litter bins and bicycle bollards. The products are made to stand outdoors in the Nordic climate, and the aluminium is melted down and reused when a product has served its time. The company still works with outside designers.
facts: Outdoor and public-space furniture, planters, litter bins, bicycle bollards

edit.standfirst: A Småland foundry, founded in 1947, making cast outdoor furniture with named designers.

designers:hella-jongerius.name: Hella Jongerius
paragraphs: Hella Jongerius is a Dutch industrial designer who studied at the Design Academy Eindhoven. She founded Jongeriuslab in Rotterdam in 1993 and moved the studio to Berlin in 2008. Her work is an open-ended research into colours, materials and textures, in which finished and semi-finished products are part of a never-ending process.

She pays attention to imperfections, traces of how a piece was made and the potential of materials and techniques. On Formground she is credited on {count} pieces shown through Galerie Kreo, among them vases, coffee tables, lounge chairs, plates and bottles. The studio's site lists projects, exhibitions and publications.
facts: Vases, coffee tables, lounge chairs, plates, bottles (as shown on Formground)
sources: Wikipedia: Hella Jongerius (founding, move to Berlin, training)

edit.standfirst: Jongeriuslab, founded in Rotterdam in 1993 and now in Berlin, researches colour, material and texture.

architects:innauer-matt-architekten.name: Innauer Matt Architekten
paragraphs: Innauer Matt Architekten is an architecture office in Bezau, in the Bregenzerwald in Austria, founded in 2012 by Markus Innauer and Sven Matt. Each task is approached close to the place, the landscape and the people who live there, joining what already exists with the new, in pursuit of a quiet, everyday kind of architecture.
On Formground its work is shown through {count} houses, among them Haus Feurstein, Haus Fink and Berghaus Eller. Each house links to its project page on the office's own site.

edit.standfirst: An office in the Bregenzerwald, founded in 2012, building close to the place and the landscape.

architects:omar-gandhi-architect.name: Omar Gandhi Architect
paragraphs: Omar Gandhi Architect is a practice founded in 2010 by Omar Gandhi, with design studios in Toronto, Halifax and Berlin. Its portfolio ranges from homes and urban infill buildings to public works and historic landscapes, with designs based on the physical character of each site and the familiar architecture of the area, reworked into new forms.

On Formground its work is shown through {count} houses, most of them in Nova Scotia, including the Rabbit Snare Gorge cabin in the Cape Breton Highlands and the Schlotfeldt Residence in British Columbia. Each links to its project page on the practice's own site.
facts: Halifax (studios also in Toronto and Berlin)

edit.standfirst: A practice founded in 2010 with studios in Toronto, Halifax and Berlin.

architects:wittman-estes.name: Wittman Estes
paragraphs: Wittman Estes is an architecture practice in Seattle that works together with landscape. It began from the view that buildings and landscapes were being designed as separate things, and sets out to design them as one, with smooth thresholds between inside and outside and a richness of natural materials. The practice is known for energy-positive prefab housing, multifamily housing and design for sensitive ecological sites.
On Formground its work is shown through {count} houses, from courtyard houses in the city to cabins on islands and by rivers. Each links to its project page on the practice's own site.

edit.standfirst: A Seattle practice that designs buildings and landscapes together.

makers:kristina-dam-studio.name: Kristina Dam Studio
paragraphs: Kristina Dam Studio is a Danish design studio with a showroom in Copenhagen, founded in 2012 by the graphic designer Kristina Dam. It began with a series of limited-edition illustrations and grew to include furniture, home textiles and sculptures. Its approach is "sculptural minimalism", joining an artist's attention to detail with an architect's vision.

Its furniture includes the Curved and Grid series, the Collector dining table and chair and the Outline series, with the oak furniture made from solid FSC-certified oak. On Formground its work is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page on the studio's site.

edit.standfirst: A Copenhagen studio, founded in 2012, working in what it calls sculptural minimalism.

makers:garsnas.name: Gärsnäs
paragraphs: Gärsnäs is a family-owned furniture maker in Gärsnäs, in Österlen in Skåne, Sweden. The carpenter Anders Andersson started the factory in 1893, and it is now run by the third generation of the Axelsson-Klockby family. The factory lies among red beech trees, and its chairs blend woodworking skill with industrial production.
The range is mainly chairs, armchairs, stools and tables, with {count} pieces shown on Formground, each linked to its own page. The modular construction of the chairs makes them easy to renovate.

edit.standfirst: A family-owned furniture maker in Skåne, started in 1893.

designers:pierre-charpin.name: Pierre Charpin
paragraphs: Pierre Charpin is a French designer, born in 1962 in Saint-Mandé near Paris, who graduated from the Beaux-Arts de Bourges in 1984. Since the early 1990s he has designed furniture and objects. His site lists research projects with the glass centre CIRVA (1998 to 2001) and the fire and earth arts centre CRAFT (2003 to 2005), and collaborations with manufacturers including Alessi, Hermès, Ligne Roset and Venini.
He lives and works in Ivry-sur-Seine, near Paris. On Formground he is credited on {count} pieces shown through Galerie Kreo, among them coffee tables, vases, mirrors and lighting.
facts: Coffee tables, vases, mirrors, lighting (as shown on Formground)

edit.standfirst: A French designer of furniture and objects, working near Paris since the early 1990s.

designers:konstantin-grcic.name: Konstantin Grcic
paragraphs: Konstantin Grcic (born 1965) trained as a cabinet maker at the John Makepeace School for Craftsmen in Wood before studying design at the Royal College of Art in London. He set up his own practice in 1991, and Konstantin Grcic Design is now based in Berlin, working on furniture, products and lighting as well as exhibition design and collaborations in architecture and fashion.
His producers include Magis, Vitra, Flos and Cassina. On Formground he is credited on {count} pieces shown through Galerie Kreo, among them tables, benches, lounge chairs and lamps.
facts: Tables, benches, lounge chairs, lamps (as shown on Formground)

edit.standfirst: A designer trained as a cabinet maker, with his own practice since 1991.

architects:tham-videgard-arkitekter.name: Tham & Videgård Arkitekter
paragraphs: Tham & Videgård, also written ThamVidegård, is an architecture office in Stockholm founded in 1999 by Bolle Tham and Martin Videgård. An experimental approach has grown into a practice with global reach. It has received the Kasper Salin Prize from Sveriges Arkitekter for the Kalmar Museum of Art and the KTH School of Architecture, and has shown work at exhibitions including the Venice Architecture Biennale and the Louisiana Museum of Modern Art.

On Formground its work is shown through {count} houses, almost all in and around Stockholm and its archipelago, among them Husarö, House V and the Archipelago House. Each links to its project page on the office's own site.

edit.standfirst: An experimental Stockholm office, founded in 1999, whose houses sit on the archipelago.

makers:davsjo.name: Davsjö
paragraphs: Davsjö is a Swedish maker of furniture and objects, led by the designer and founder David Sjöberg. The furniture is rooted in Scandinavian craftsmanship and made to last, with a process that starts from the question of what problem is being solved. Traditional craftsmanship is combined with modern manufacturing, and each piece is designed and made in its factory in Northern Sweden.

The range on Formground includes dining tables, folding dining chairs, bar stools, step ladders with wall mounts and ash cutlery, with {count} pieces shown, each linked to its own page. The folding mechanism of the DS10 and DS11 dining chairs is built into the design.
facts: Dining tables, dining chairs, bar stools, step ladders, cutlery

edit.standfirst: A Swedish maker of ash furniture and objects, designed and made in Northern Sweden.

architects:welsh-major.name: Welsh + Major
paragraphs: Welsh + Major is an architecture practice in Sydney, established in 2004 by David Welsh and Chris Major, working across architecture, interiors, planning and urban design. Its architects call themselves "modern-ish": a broad modernist sensibility that is not bound by the dogma of materials, and that responds to programme and context rather than reacting to them.

On Formground its work is shown through {count} houses, most of them in New South Wales, among them Seagrass House, Annandale House and Twin Set. Each links to its project page on the practice's own site.
facts: Architecture, interiors, planning and urban design (houses shown on Formground)

edit.standfirst: A Sydney practice, established in 2004, that calls itself modern-ish.

makers:sizar-alexis.name: Sizar Alexis
paragraphs: Sizar Alexis is an Iraqi-born, Sweden-based designer who makes objects and sculptural furniture in geometric forms. Born in Ankawa, near Erbil in northern Iraq, he moved to Sweden with his family in 1997 and settled in Eskilstuna. He studied at Beckmans College of Design and holds degrees in engineering (2009) and fine arts (2019).

His work explores the raw beauty of natural materials and draws on the architectural and spiritual heritage of ancient Mesopotamia and his Chaldean background. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, among them the Lahmu coffee table, the Ousia and Ode chairs and the Pilier console.

edit.standfirst: An Iraqi-born, Sweden-based designer making sculptural furniture and objects in geometric forms.

architects:stra-arkitekter.name: STRÅ arkitekter
paragraphs: STRÅ is an Oslo-based architecture practice working in architecture and urban design, established in 2021 and directed by Anders Byng Strøm and Gustav Jerlvall Jeppsson. The work ranges from bespoke vacation homes and villas to large buildings, public spaces and strategic planning, rooted in the Scandinavian design tradition and marked by "both rigor and playfulness". The office sits in a storefront space in Majorstua, shared with a small coworking community.
On Formground its work is shown through {count} houses, among them Knarrvika, Villa Sandnes and Strandhuset. Each links to its project page on the practice's own site.
facts: Architecture and urban design (houses shown on Formground)

edit.standfirst: An Oslo practice, established in 2021, designing vacation homes, villas and public buildings.

makers:mabeo-furniture.name: Mabeo Furniture
paragraphs: Mabeo is a furniture maker in Botswana that began by making furniture for commercial projects. It has since moved to making simple objects through a hands-on dialogue with artisans and craftspeople in Botswana, working with international designers including Patricia Urquiola, Vincent Van Duysen and Claesson Koivisto Rune.

The Lesire collection, designed by Mabeo Studio, is made in Panga Panga wood from a community environmental preservation project in neighbouring Mozambique. On Formground the maker is shown through {count} pieces, among them the Kika stool, the Embi series and the Tswana folding chair.

edit.standfirst: A furniture maker in Botswana working with local craftspeople and international designers.

makers:another-country.name: Another Country
paragraphs: Another Country is a company founded in 2010 that designs and makes contemporary wood furniture and home accessories in the UK and Portugal. Its designs draw on archetype, from British country kitchen style, Shaker and traditional Scandinavian and Japanese woodwork, and its wooden products are made from sustainable timbers.

Most of its numbered furniture series are designed in-house, and it also works with outside designers, including David Irwin (the Hardy Collection) and Ian McIntyre (the Pottery Series). On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

edit.standfirst: A UK furniture company, founded in 2010, making contemporary wood furniture in the UK and Portugal.

makers:fogia.name: Fogia
paragraphs: Fogia is a Swedish furniture maker whose work since 1981 has been shaped by craftsmanship, material knowledge and close collaboration between designers and makers. Its own factory has wood workshops and studios for upholstery, cutting and sewing, so ideas can be tested and refined close to production. Its approach is function and friction: a piece needs both.

It has showrooms in Stockholm, Gothenburg and Oslo, with its flagship store in Stockholm. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, from sofas and lounge chairs to tables, shelves and lighting, each linked to its own page.
facts: 1981 (stated as the start of its way of working)

makers:mokko-amsterdam.name: Mokko Amsterdam
paragraphs: Mokko is an Amsterdam-based design studio founded in 2017 and led by the designer Aad Bos. Its furniture and objects have a sculptural presence, drawn from archetypal forms, volumes and voids, and are made to be used, cared for and repaired over generations.

Every piece is made to order by artisans in the Netherlands, in solid wood from responsibly managed forests. The collection is shown in its Amsterdam showroom and in selected showrooms and galleries abroad, including Boon Room in Paris and Love House in New York. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces.

makers:ed-heritage.name: Ed Heritage
paragraphs: Ed Heritage is a UK design studio led by its founder, Ed, a product and furniture designer with a background in architecture and an MA from Kingston School of Art. The work explores how design can deepen the emotional connection between people and objects, using clean geometry, playful interaction and a balance of form, function and material.

Its one product on Formground is the TILT lamp, a rechargeable table lamp that switches on and off when you tilt it, made of solid FSC-certified European ash, glass and metal. It is designed in the UK and made in the PRC, with stockists in the UK and Japan.

makers:host-toast.name: Host & Toast
paragraphs: Host & Toast is a design and fabrication studio that makes furniture, objects and custom builds. Since 2013 it has designed and built custom interiors, event installations and furniture by hand, with work grounded in brand alignment, material honesty and deliberate restraint, favouring longevity over trends.

Its online shop offers a selection of furniture and objects, among them the Eld chair, the Pinstripe side table and the Sill credenza, with {count} pieces shown on Formground, each linked to its own page. Interior designers, architects and trade professionals can ask about consultations, pricing and lead times.

makers:20by8.name: 20by8
paragraphs: 20by8, also written Twentybyeight, is a small workshop run by Sergei Grigorev, a designer based in Cyprus who worked for many years as an interior designer. He makes chairs, mostly, by hand in small batches, with a focus on high-end craftsmanship, distinctive design and premium materials.

He takes responsibility for the whole process, from the first sketch to the last stitch, and finds the balance between design and craft the most interesting part. On Formground the workshop is shown through {count} pieces, among them the Fourth chair, the Eero chair and the Stauros armchair; prices are given on request through an inquiry form.

designers:space-copenhagen.name: Space Copenhagen
paragraphs: Space Copenhagen is a design studio in Copenhagen, founded in 2005 by Signe Bindslev Henriksen and Peter Bundgaard Rützou. It works across interior design for homes, hotels and restaurants worldwide, art installations and art direction, furniture, lighting and refined objects. Its approach, Poetic Modernism, balances opposites such as classic and modern, industrial and organic, sculptural and minimal.

Its interiors include the 11 Howard hotel in New York and the restaurants Geranium and the first Noma in Copenhagen, and it has designed for manufacturers including GUBI, Fredericia, &Tradition and Mater. On Formground it is credited on {count} pieces.

architects:sanden-hodnekvam-architects.name: Sanden+Hodnekvam Architects
paragraphs: Sanden+Hodnekvam Architects is an architecture studio founded in 2014 by John Sanden and Ingvild Hodnekvam, based in Oslo and Nesodden in Norway. The work balances simplicity of form with richness in tectonics and atmosphere, seeking rational, aesthetic and sustainable solutions with honesty of materials and construction.

The studio is one of six selected for Norway's national scenic route programme 2022 to 2029, and its work has been nominated for the European Union Prize for Contemporary Architecture, the Mies van der Rohe Award. On Formground it is shown through {count} houses, each linked to its project page.

makers:vikens-hantverkeri.name: Vikens Hantverkeri
paragraphs: Vikens Hantverkeri is a Swedish maker of tables on Lidingö, near Stockholm. Its tables are made to measure in marble and wood, with more than 50 kinds of marble on offer, depending on what the quarries supply, and a wide choice of woods and finishes. Customers can design their own table, or ask for a wood that is not listed.

On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, from dining and coffee tables to a desk, a bar table and a shelf, each linked to its own page. Prices on its site start from the lowest configuration, with size and material chosen when ordering.
facts: Tables, a desk, a shelf, a wine rack
Yes (made to measure, stated on their site)

makers:fine-little-day.name: Fine Little Day
paragraphs: Fine Little Day is a Swedish design studio with roots in Gothenburg, founded in 2007 by Elisabeth Dunker, a designer and photographer. It began as a personal blog and has grown into a producer of textiles, lifestyle products and interior details, inspired by a respect for nature.

The range includes posters and wall art, home textiles, tablecloths, cushions and crafts, shown on Formground through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page. The studio's vision is sustainable and artistically driven.
facts: Textiles, posters and wall art, cushions, interior accents

makers:tala.name: Tala
paragraphs: Tala is a lighting company founded in 2015 by three friends from Edinburgh University, now headquartered in London. It designs LED lighting with a low carbon footprint in mind, using recyclable materials such as aluminium and hardwoods, and is a certified B Corp.

Its bulbs are designed for high colour rendering, low flicker and dim-to-warm light, and free design consultations are offered at its London showroom. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, from pendants and chandeliers to portable lamps, each linked to its own page.

makers:sibast.name: Sibast
paragraphs: Sibast Furniture is a Danish furniture maker with a family story. Helge Sibast, born in 1908 on the island of Funen, grew from a cabinetmaker's apprentice into the head of a furniture factory that employed over 120 craftsmen by the 1950s and 60s.

His grandson and his wife relaunched the company in 2013, beginning with the Sibast No 8 chair he designed in 1953, and have since continued to bring his designs back into production. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.
facts: Relaunched in 2013 (the original company dates from the mid-1900s)

makers:northern.name: Northern
paragraphs: Northern is a design company based in Oslo, founded in 2005 as Northern Lighting and focused on lighting until 2018. Its collection now also includes furniture and other design objects, made with both new and experienced designers and skilled craftspeople.

It is a Norwegian producer and brand, a local design firm with a global perspective, and supports new design talent when it finds it. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:pinch.name: Pinch
paragraphs: Pinch is a London furniture and lighting company founded in 2004 by Russell Pinch and Oona Bannon. Its look is quiet and elegant, with a focus on craft: pieces are made by skilled craftspeople in the UK and Europe, and designed to endure and be inherited.

It holds stock of many pieces, can finish some in bespoke colours, and takes custom orders. It sells from its showroom in London's Pimlico Road district and ships worldwide. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces.
facts: Custom versions and bespoke commissions offered (stated on their site)

makers:antidark.name: Antidark
paragraphs: Antidark is a Danish lighting company. Its collection is characteristic, minimal and timeless, designed to shape a room with the right mood and light, indoors or out.

It works as a design team rather than around one designer, and each product passes through many hands, from first sketches to the finishing of materials. Quality and listening to customers are named as priorities. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:luke-hope.name: Luke Hope
paragraphs: Luke Hope is a designer and maker of wooden objects. He studied design, spent about twenty years doing other work, and returned to designing and making around ten years ago, drawn to the slow, meditative process of shaping forms from a single piece of wood.

He works between studios in London and Central Vietnam and makes functional objects and sculptural work, with a mix of traditional handwork, CNC milling and hand finishing. On Formground he is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.
facts: United Kingdom and Vietnam (studios in London and Central Vietnam)

makers:project-213a.name: Project 213A
paragraphs: Project 213A is a European design house that launched in 2021, founded by Jurgita Dileviciute, Theresa Marx and Clement Deboeuf. The name refers to a London address where the founders each lived while studying.

The focus is traditional craftsmanship and lasting design that avoids trends, with products made locally in the studio's in-house ceramic and wood workshops, helped by skilled artisans from Northern Portugal. Most collections are named after Portuguese cities and areas. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces.

makers:valerie-objects.name: Valerie Objects
paragraphs: Valerie Objects is a Belgian design label started by Axel Van Den Bossche, the founder of Serax, and Veerle Wenes, owner of the Valerie Traan gallery. Its aim is to let designers and artists turn their signature style into objects for daily use.

The design duo Muller Van Severen was the first to sign, and the label has since worked with designers such as Maarten Baas and Studio Wieki Somers. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, from furniture and lighting to table art, each linked to its own page.
facts: Furniture, lighting, table art and objects

makers:louise-roe.name: Louise Roe
paragraphs: Louise Roe is a Copenhagen interior brand founded by Louise Roe Andersen. Its collection moves between furniture, lighting, textiles and sculptural objects, shaped by material and a feel for form and atmosphere.

It has two capsule lines: Roe Studio, which is avant-garde experimentation, and the S.R. Collection, a tableware series made in collaboration with family. The brand also runs Louise Roe Gallery, a concept space and café in Copenhagen. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.
facts: Furniture, lighting, textiles and sculptural objects

makers:oi-soi-oi.name: Oi Soi Oi
paragraphs: Oi Soi Oi is a Danish company founded in 2007 by Britt Goodall and Christina Thorbøll, which designs and produces its own range for the home. Everything is handmade in Vietnam, where Britt Goodall has lived for more than twenty years and built the team that handles design and production.

The name is Vietnamese for "wow". The company blends clean Scandinavian lines with colourful Asian influences, and works with small family-run workshops rather than a factory. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces.
sources: Oi Soi Oi: About us (in Danish)

makers:in-common-with.name: In Common With
paragraphs: In Common With is a design studio founded in 2018 by Felicia Hung and Nick Ozemba. It works on lighting and objects, bringing old-world craft together with manufacturing at scale, and builds its work on collaboration between artists, materials and the people it works with.
A team of craftspeople, artists and engineers around the world shapes shades in ceramic and glass. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:wendelbo.name: Wendelbo
paragraphs: Wendelbo is a Danish furniture company founded in 1955 as a small family workshop specialising in upholstery. Three generations have kept upholstery at the core, and the company now works with designers from around the world.

Its furniture is produced at its own production in Ho Chi Minh City, where skilled hands work with fabric, leather and foam every day. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:apparatus.name: Apparatus
paragraphs: Apparatus is a New York design studio co-founded in 2012 by Gabriel Hendifar and Jeremy Anderson. It is an interdisciplinary studio exploring how lighting, furniture and objects relate to their surroundings, with each collection built around a single imagined world.

Pieces are made in the studio's own New York factory, combining materials such as marble, suede, horsehair, lacquer and porcelain with hand-patinated brass. It operates galleries in New York, Los Angeles and London. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces.

makers:woud.name: Woud
paragraphs: Woud is a Danish design brand started by the founders Mia and Torben Koed, who drew on thirty years of experience to build a brand from the ground up, launched in 2015. Its collection looks ahead rather than back, with a modern take on Scandinavian simplicity.
It works with both upcoming and experienced designers from many countries, from Japan to Canada. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:101cph.name: 101cph
paragraphs: 101 Copenhagen is a Danish design brand founded in 2017, rooted in Scandinavian soil and nourished by Japanese minimalist aesthetics. Tommy Hyldahl and Kristian Sofus Hansen are its two main designers, with backgrounds in fashion and at the Royal Danish Academy of Fine Arts.

The brand covers furniture, lighting and accessories, with collections that are sculptural and conceptual, and an emphasis on materials and craftsmanship. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces.

makers:lambert-fils.name: Lambert & Fils
paragraphs: Lambert & Fils is a lighting studio founded in Montreal in 2010 by Samuel Lambert, which began as a small design atelier. All of its lighting is handmade in its Montreal atelier, where it prototypes in-house and has developed its own LED technology to keep the warmth of incandescent light.
It makes original collections and collaborates with emerging designers around the world. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:llot-llov.name: Llot Llov
paragraphs: Llot Llov is a Berlin studio for product and interior design, founded in 2006 by Ania Bauer and Jacob Brinck, which also produces its own furniture, objects, lighting and surfaces. It reinterprets traditional arts and crafts in a contemporary context.

Its signature surfaces are OSIS, a wood finish made with salt crystals and colour pigments, and GLACIER, a terrazzo made from upcycled nail polish bottles. Objects are made in Europe, often in social workshops. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces.

designers:jonah-takagi.name: Jonah Takagi
paragraphs: Jonah Takagi is a furniture and product designer with a BFA in Furniture Design from the Rhode Island School of Design. After several years on the road as a touring musician, he founded his studio in 2010, and has since exhibited work throughout Europe and America.

His clients include MillerKnoll, Kvadrat, Roll & Hill, Le Klint, Design Within Reach, Umbra, SCP, LK Hjelle and Hem, and he has taught and led workshops at schools including the Rhode Island School of Design and Cranbrook Academy. On Formground he is shown through {count} of his projects, each linked to its own page on his site.

designers:krystian-kowalski.name: Krystian Kowalski
paragraphs: Krystian Kowalski is a Warsaw-based industrial designer, raised in a family of sculptors, who treats design as an analytical process and explores the language of objects through form, materiality and technology. He studied at the Royal College of Art in London (MA 2010) and the Academy of Fine Arts in Warsaw.

He set up his own practice in 2013 after working at studios in Warsaw and Milan, co-founded Kompott Studio, and was Creative Director at Tylko from 2016 to 2021. Today he designs for furniture and product brands. On Formground he is shown through {count} of his projects, each linked to its own page on his site.

designers:sho-ota.name: Sho Ota
paragraphs: Sho Ota is a Japanese object maker, designer and artist based in Eindhoven in the Netherlands, who graduated from the Contextual Design department at Design Academy Eindhoven in 2018.

His work has been shown at Dutch Design Week, Designtide Tokyo, MK&G Messe in Hamburg, 21_21 Design Sight in Tokyo, Alcova in Milan and Collectible, among other places. On Formground he is shown through {count} of his works, including the Knot round stool and Bench no 4, each linked to its own page on his site.

designers:giulio-zizzari.name: Giulio Zizzari
paragraphs: Giulio Zizzari (born 1996) is an Italian designer whose practice moves between collectible design, architecture and image-making. His design work centres on sculptural furniture and objects, made as singular pieces and in limited series.

Alongside it he runs STUDIOGZ, a 3D visualisation and creative direction studio for architecture and design. On Formground he is shown through {count} numbered and signed pieces from 2026, among them the Eros stool, the Leviatano dining table and the Teti totem bookshelf, each linked to its own page on his site.

architects:elding-oscarson.name: Elding Oscarson
paragraphs: Elding Oscarson is a Stockholm architecture office launched in 2007, on the conviction that its founders' combined architectural backgrounds would give thoughtful answers to a range of architectural problems. It works across several fields, scales and building types, treating every commission as a chance to question conventions, and follows a rigorous design process from vision and concept through to detailing and realisation.

The office has received the Kasper Salin Prize, the highest Swedish honour in architecture, and its work in Sweden and abroad has been widely published. On Formground it is shown through {count} houses, each linked to its project page.

architects:forstberg-ling.name: Förstberg Ling
paragraphs: Förstberg Ling is a Malmö studio founded in 2015 by Björn Förstberg and Mikael Ling. Its approach to architecture and design is rooted in understanding the assignment while challenging conventions, and in the belief that drawings are instructions and the built object is everything.

For its project Twelve Houses the studio took the roles of architect, developer and main contractor. It was completed in 2022, nominated for the Kasper Salin Prize that year and won the Bostadspriset in 2023. On Formground it is shown through {count} houses.

architects:murman-arkitekter.name: Murman Arkitekter
paragraphs: Murman Arkitekter is a Stockholm office founded in 1985 by Hans Murman. Among its first clients were some of Stockholm's best-known advertising agencies, and it soon grew to design workplaces, homes and leisure houses. Today more than 30 architects, planners, building engineers and interior architects work there, with particular skill in modern timber construction.

Its better-known projects include the landmark Turebergshuset and Sida's head office in Rissne. The office is owned by five partners, with Hans Murman still active. On Formground it is shown through {count} houses, each linked to its project page.

architects:atelje-o.name: Ateljé Ö
paragraphs: Ateljé Ö is an architecture practice in Visby on Gotland. It regards architecture as one of the fine arts and builds much of its work on the Gotland landscape, taking projects on the island, the mainland and abroad. The team believes buildings can reconnect people with nature, spark joy and give calm.

The practice specialises in taking a project from first idea to handing over the key, in close collaboration with craftsmen and builders. The team is Sara Patriksson, Kalle Söderman, John Ridderstolpe, Mats Wahlström Walter and Joel Winsnes. On Formground it is shown through {count} houses.

architects:johan-sundberg-arkitektur.name: Johan Sundberg Arkitektur
paragraphs: Johan Sundberg Arkitektur (JSA) is a practice with offices in Lund and Stockholm, started in 2005 by Johan Sundberg, who trained at Lund University of Technology and still teaches there. The office now has 13 architects of several nationalities and works in English and Swedish, on commissions in Sweden and abroad.

Its work ranges from private villas and summer houses to complex public buildings, and Johan Sundberg also works on graphic form, furniture design and interiors. On Formground it is shown through {count} houses, each linked to its project page.

architects:karlsson-lauri-arkitekter.name: Karlsson/Lauri Arkitekter
paragraphs: Karlsson/Lauri Arkitekter is a Malmö office founded in 2020 by Mats Karlsson and Tomas Lauri, who earlier ran the competition-winning firm ARKLAB. It aims for architecture where culture and landscape shape innovative, humane solutions, and treats design as the tool that makes the difference.

Mats Karlsson is also an artist who has exhibited widely, and Tomas Lauri is a speaker and editor who has written or edited about a dozen books and was editor-in-chief of Arkitektur. On Formground the office is shown through {count} houses.

architects:campus.name: CAMPUS
paragraphs: CAMPUS is a Stockholm architecture and design studio whose portfolio spans urban design, architecture, landscape, interiors and product design, in culture, retail, workplace and residential projects. Its best-known work includes Fotografiska in Stockholm and London, Hyttgårdsparken and KaDeWe Düsseldorf.

The studio was founded by the architects Johan Berglund and Jani Kristoffersen, who together have more than 40 years of experience across architecture, interiors, landscape and urban design. On Formground it is shown through {count} houses, each linked to its project page.

architects:rever-drage-architects.name: Rever & Drage Architects
paragraphs: Rever & Drage is an architectural office in Oslo, founded by the architects Eirik Lilledrange, Martin Beverfjord and Tom Auger. Between them the partners bring specialities in wooden construction, prefabrication, facade composition, architectural theory and complex building programmes.
Selected clients include the Norwegian Public Roads Administration and Statskog. On Formground the office is shown through {count} houses, each linked to its project page.

architects:koht-arkitekter.name: KOHT Arkitekter
paragraphs: KOHT is an Oslo architecture studio founded in late 2016 by Anders Bjørneseth, Kenneth Lønning, Jonas Velken Kverneland and Christopher Wilkens. It works on projects from single-family homes and cabins to planning and urban strategies, and gained recognition early by winning a two-stage competition to expand the NTNU campus in Trondheim.

The following year it was named Årets nykommer (newcomer of the year) by Design and Architecture Norway. The studio puts weight on collaboration and dialogue, and is based at Sagene in Oslo. On Formground it is shown through {count} houses.

architects:galeotti-rizzato-architetti.name: Galeotti Rizzato Architetti
paragraphs: Galeotti/Rizzato is an architecture studio in Treviso, Italy, run by Massimo Galeotti and Elisa Rizzato. Massimo Galeotti graduated in architecture at IUAV University of Venice in 2005 and set up his own studio in 2010; Elisa Rizzato graduated there in 2017 and began working with him in 2014. They founded Galeotti/Rizzato together in 2020.

Since 2018 Massimo Galeotti has also been a founding partner of Spazio Solido, a space dedicated to architecture. On Formground the studio is shown through {count} houses, each linked to its project page.

architects:herbst-architects.name: Herbst Architects
paragraphs: Herbst Architects is an Auckland practice founded in 2000 by Lance and Nicola Herbst, who met studying architecture at the University of Cape Town and emigrated to New Zealand in 1998. One of their first projects was their own bach on Great Barrier Island, which won a New Zealand Institute of Architects Award in 2002.

The island is now home to eight of their houses, all off the grid and designed for minimal impact on the environment. The practice keeps asking how best to live in and feel connected to the New Zealand landscape and climate. On Formground it is shown through {count} houses.

architects:surman-weston.name: Surman Weston
paragraphs: Surman Weston is a London practice, founded in 2014 and led by Tom Surman and Percy Weston, specialising in new build and retrofit homes and schools across the south of England. It avoids a house style, spending the early stages analysing the brief and context so that designs respond to place, materials and use.

The partners regularly teach and lecture at institutions including the University of Cambridge, the University of Nottingham and the Royal Institute of British Architects. On Formground the practice is shown through {count} houses, each linked to its project page.

architects:sandy-rendel-architects.name: Sandy Rendel Architects
paragraphs: Sandy Rendel Architects is a London practice founded in 2010, offering architecture, interior and urban design across a wide range of project types. Its work responds to the physical, environmental and cultural context of each project, with a sustainable approach aimed at low environmental impact and a long life.

It enjoys both traditional construction craft and modern technologies, and was named RIBA South East Emerging Practice of the Year in 2017. On Formground it is shown through {count} houses, each linked to its project page.

architects:sanei-hopkins-architects.name: Sanei + Hopkins Architects
paragraphs: Sanei Hopkins Architects is a London practice founded in 2002 by Amir Sanei and Abigail Hopkins, with more than 20 years of experience in thoughtful, sustainable architecture. It approaches each project with fresh eyes, combining creative imagination with rational logic, and has been selected for both UK 40 under 40 and Europe 40 under 40.

Its work has received RIBA awards, including a 2023 regional award for The Secret Garden, and has been shown at the Royal Academy of Arts and the Victoria & Albert Museum. On Formground it is shown through {count} houses.

architects:rx-architects.name: RX Architects
paragraphs: RX Architects is a design-led practice in Rye, East Sussex, founded in 2016 and led by Derek Rankin and Rob Pollard, who have collaborated for ten years. It specialises in high-end residential and mixed-use commercial projects, built on a constant dialogue between architect, client and contractor, with a focus on sustainable design and a response to site.

The name refers to the RX fishing boat registration code of Rye and Hastings. The studio overlooks the River Rother and works from the south coast of Sussex and Kent to London. On Formground it is shown through {count} houses.

makers:seletti.name: Seletti
paragraphs: Seletti is an Italian design brand based in Cicognara, Mantova, which has linked design to pop art since its first year in 1964. The company focuses on design projects and distinctive Italian creativity, with collections that blend art with everyday icons.

Its aim is a vision of a unique, personal and fun lifestyle, and a continuing journey through ideas of beauty with new productions. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:ferm-living.name: Ferm Living
paragraphs: Ferm Living is a Copenhagen design brand that crafts furniture, accessories and lighting around soft forms, rich textures and curious details. Driven by a love for authentic design and responsible choices, it describes its products as honest and its settings as calm, helping people balance life's contrasts.

From Copenhagen it works with partners around the world, fusing a Scandinavian mindset with global skills and traditions. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:alessi.name: Alessi
paragraphs: Alessi is an Italian maker of design objects, active since 1921 and calling itself the Dream Factory. For over a century it has made objects meant to bring poetry and emotion into everyday life, working with more than 900 designers, architects and artists.
Its catalogue holds more than 1,400 creations, and many pieces have become icons housed in major art and design museums. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:tradition.name: &Tradition
paragraphs: &Tradition is an international design brand founded in Copenhagen in 2010, built on a Danish legacy of craftsmanship and design. It designs the classics of tomorrow, from newly designed pieces to reissues, with a collection of furniture, lighting and interior objects that reaches back to mid-century icons.

The range includes Verner Panton's Flowerpot lamp, first produced in the late 1960s, and Arne Jacobsen and Flemming Lassen's Mayor sofa. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:dixie.name: Dixie
paragraphs: Dixie is a Swedish supplier of functional, timeless interior products, with more than 25 years behind it. Its range starts from the Scandinavian tradition of form, with soft natural colours, considered function and genuine materials.

The company has built long relationships with carefully chosen manufacturers who meet its requirements on materials, production methods and working conditions, and sells to several countries. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces.

makers:tell-me-more.name: Tell Me More
paragraphs: Tell Me More is a Swedish interior brand created in 2011 by AnnaLena Jönsson and Marcus Eliasson, who came from fashion and interiors and wanted to make something lasting at a pace that allows reflection. It began with stonewashed linen bedding and hemp rugs, and has grown into a concept for the whole home, now with glass, ceramics and porcelain.

The head office, showroom and concept store are in Gothenburg. The brand works with natural materials and timeless shapes and colours, for products meant to be used and loved every day. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces.
facts: Textiles, rugs, glass, ceramics and porcelain

makers:living-divani.name: Living Divani
paragraphs: Living Divani is an Italian furniture company founded in 1969 by Renata Pozzoli and Luigi Bestetti, based in Brianza, the heart of the Italian furniture district. Family-owned, it has made upholstery its trademark, with proportions and a feeling of understated luxury as its distinguishing features.

Piero Lissoni has been its art director and designer since 1988, and Carola Bestetti, the second generation, has led a newer phase of working with international designers and young talents. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:gervasoni.name: Gervasoni
paragraphs: Gervasoni is a family business founded in 1882 in the province of Udine, Italy, which began as a small artisan workshop specialising in wickerwork. It passed to Giovanni Gervasoni in 1925 and is now managed by the third generation, Giovanni and Michele Gervasoni.

It makes indoor and outdoor furniture, combining industrial and natural materials with craft techniques, and Paola Navone was its artistic director until 2020. Gervasoni joined Dexelance in 2015. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces.

makers:zero.name: Zero
paragraphs: Zero is a Swedish lighting company, founded in 1978 as Zero Interiör to make unique light fixtures for a design-interested audience. Its principles are quality, environmental care and innovation, with the idea of making technical lighting decorative.

More than 80% of manufacturing takes place within about 200 km of Nybro in Småland, and all assembly happens in its workshop in Nybro. The founders, Roland Gill and Andris Nolendorfs, chose the name because they were starting from nothing. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces.

makers:le-klint.name: Le Klint
paragraphs: Le Klint is a Danish lighting maker whose story begins around 1900, when the architect and engineer Peder Vilhelm Jensen-Klint folded a paper shade for a petroleum lamp, inspired by Japanese origami. His cross-pleating technique gave the shade a collar at 90 degrees to the straight pleats.

Folding paper into shades became a Klint family pastime, drawing in his sons Tage and Kaare, and grew into the company. Jensen-Klint is also known for Grundtvig's Church in Copenhagen. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:kann-design.name: Kann Design
paragraphs: Kann Design is an editor and manufacturer of furniture, created in 2010 by Houssam Kanaan with Meghedi Simonian and Rudy Bou Chebel. It publishes pieces by talented designers and controls the whole production chain, from first sketches to sale.

Kanaan comes from a family of cabinetmakers: his father founded the Kanaan workshop in 1958 in Beit-Chabab in Lebanon, which lets Kann take on ambitious editions, and since 2017 his brother has run it. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces.

makers:vaarnii.name: Vaarnii
paragraphs: Vaarnii is a Finnish furniture company that makes what it calls brutal and sophisticated objects from a single natural raw material, Finnish pine, with local craftspeople and factories in Finland. It uses solid natural materials, inspired by the efficiency of vernacular design.

Its first collection is made entirely from Scots pine, the most common tree in Finland, and it works with a small number of Finnish makers, from larger factories that specialise in one kind of manufacturing to small workshops and individual craftspeople. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces.

makers:salma.name: Salma
paragraphs: Salma is a Portuguese manufacturer of bespoke furniture, including upholstery, cabinetry and metalwork. Every piece is handcrafted by highly skilled craftsmen, with meticulous attention to detail, and the company is based in Palhaça in Portugal.

It combines a passion for perfection and quality with a dedication to service, and puts its clients' satisfaction first. Catalogues can be downloaded from its site. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.
facts: Bespoke furniture: upholstery, cabinetry and metalwork

makers:noom.name: Noom
paragraphs: NOOM is a design brand at the intersection of design and art, founded in 2017 by Kateryna Sokolova and Arkadii Vartanov. It makes expressive but timeless interior objects, turning metal, wood, glass and stone into functional pieces inspired by architecture, art and cultural heritage.

The founders draw on decades of experience in industrial and interior design and oversee every stage of production, blending traditional craftsmanship with modern technology. NOOM also assists architects with bespoke designs in noble metals. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces.
facts: Interior objects, furniture and lighting in metal, wood, glass and stone

makers:ghidini-1961.name: Ghidini 1961
paragraphs: Ghidini 1961 is an Italian maker rooted in brass metalworking: Giuseppe Ghidini founded the company in 1961 to produce brass components for the lighting industry. The whole production cycle takes place in-house, from pressure die casting and lost-wax casting to machining, satin-finishing, sand-blasting and polishing.

In recent years it has built a full furniture range, including sofas, chairs, tables, storage, bookcases and lamps, made to be passed down through generations. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces.

makers:danny-kaplan-studio.name: Danny Kaplan Studio
paragraphs: Danny Kaplan Studio is a New York maker of lighting and furniture. Its showroom, open by appointment, is on Lafayette Street in Manhattan's NoHo district: a renovated 4,000-square-foot space in a pre-war cast iron building that combines showroom with Danny Kaplan's private residence.

Beyond its core lighting collection, the studio has expanded into furniture and rugs, working in collaboration with well-known and emerging designers. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:artek.name: Artek
paragraphs: Artek is a Finnish design company, standing for Art & Technology since 1935. Its collection consists of furniture, lighting and accessories designed by Finnish masters and international designers.
The range includes standard collection pieces and special editions, as well as pre-loved pieces through Artek 2nd Cycle. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:galvin-brothers.name: Galvin Brothers
paragraphs: Galvin Brothers is a family furniture business in Beverley, East Yorkshire, founded in November 2012. It makes handcrafted pieces in solid timber, including tables, desks, stools, seating, sideboards, cabinets, beds and lighting.

The furniture is built by a team of craftspeople in its own UK workshops, drawing on the family's long experience in joinery and cabinet making. The timber comes from FSC or PEFC certified sources, and the designs favour simple forms and traditional techniques used in modern ways.
On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.
facts: Handcrafted solid timber furniture and lighting

makers:serax.name: Serax
paragraphs: Serax is a Belgian design brand based in Antwerp, founded in 1986 by brothers Serge and Axel Van Den Bossche and still run as a family business. It offers dinnerware, glassware, lighting, vases and pottery, home accessories and furniture.

Axel heads the company and curates each collection with the Antwerp team. Many pieces are developed with outside designers, among them Paola Navone, Vincent Van Duysen and Piet Boon, and are produced by craftspeople around the world in materials such as stone, wood, metal, glass and clay.
On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.
facts: Tableware, lighting, home accessories and furniture

makers:ligne-roset.name: Ligne Roset
paragraphs: Ligne Roset is a furniture company based in Briord, in the Ain department of France, with a family manufacturing tradition dating back to 1860. The range covers upholstered seating, beds, tables, storage, lighting, rugs and accessories, developed with designers such as Pierre Guariche (the Président desk) and Marie C Dorner (the Abandon bed).

Production is spread over five factories in the Ain, Rhône and Isère areas, with upholstery done largely by hand in Briord and apprentices trained in-house. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.
facts: Upholstered seating, beds, tables, storage, lighting, rugs

makers:piet-hein-eek.name: Piet Hein Eek
paragraphs: Piet Hein Eek is a furniture maker in Eindhoven, the Netherlands, known for furniture and objects in scrap wood. The designer graduated from Design Academy Eindhoven in 1990 with a scrap wood cabinet that became a signature piece, and products and components are made in-house in a former Philips ceramics workshop that also holds a showroom, gallery, hotel and restaurants.

The range covers furniture, lighting, accessories, kitchens and ceramics, along with custom-made pieces and commissioned interiors. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:hay.name: HAY
paragraphs: HAY is a Danish design brand with its head office in Horsens, Denmark, founded in 2002 by Mette and Rolf Hay. It produces contemporary furniture and accessories using industrial manufacturing, with the aim of making good design available to a wide audience.

The range is developed with outside designers, among them Hee Welling, who created the About A chair series and the outdoor Hee Collection, and Ronan and Erwan Bouroullec. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:porta-romana.name: Porta Romana
paragraphs: Porta Romana is a British lighting and furniture company founded in 1988 by Andrew and Sarah Hills, who began in a small workshop in the UK. The range covers table, floor, wall, ceiling and outdoor lighting, lampshades, sofas, chairs, tables, benches and mirrors.

Pieces are handcrafted and hand-finished, and a painting studio keeps a library of hand-painted finishes. Every piece is made to order, with finishes and fabrics that can be customised, and bespoke work is also offered. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.
sources: Hotel Designs: Inside the factory with Porta Romana

makers:frama.name: Frama
paragraphs: Frama is a multi-disciplinary design brand based in Copenhagen, Denmark. It makes furniture, lighting, home objects, fragrances and self-care products, working mainly with natural materials such as oak, birch, steel, aluminium, ceramic and glass.

Its studio and store are housed in a pharmacy building from 1878 in the Nyboder district, and the brand frames its work around mindful living. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.
facts: Furniture, lighting, home objects, fragrances and self-care products

makers:mater.name: Mater
paragraphs: Mater is a furniture and lighting company founded in 2006 in Copenhagen, Denmark, by Henrik Marstrand. It makes stools, chairs, tables and outdoor furniture, using recycled aluminium, recycled plastic, FSC-certified wood and waste-based materials.

Its Matek materials are blends developed from industrial fibre and plastic waste, and a take-back system launched in 2022 lets Matek furniture be returned for recycling. Mater works with designers including Space Copenhagen, Patricia Urquiola, and Jørgen and Nanna Ditzel. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:multiforme.name: Multiforme
paragraphs: Multiforme is a Murano glass lighting maker in Trebaseleghe, near Padua in Italy, founded in 2009. It makes chandeliers, table lamps, ceiling fixtures, floor lamps and wall lights, with its glassworks and offices in the Veneto lighting district.

Besides the standard range, it designs and builds custom and oversized chandeliers with architects and designers, makes prototypes and mock-ups, and restores historic chandeliers. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:santa-cole.name: Santa & Cole
paragraphs: Santa & Cole is a Spanish editor of lighting, furniture, art and books, founded in 1985 by Javier Nieto Santa, Gabriel Ordeig Cole and Nina Masó. Its lighting covers table, floor, pendant, wall and outdoor lamps, and its furniture includes seating and tables.

It publishes work by outside designers, among them Miguel Milá, whose TMM lamp joined the catalogue in 1987. Since 2003 the company has been based at Parc de Belloch, north of Barcelona. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:galerie-kreo.name: Galerie Kreo
paragraphs: Galerie kreo is a design gallery in Paris, founded in 1999 by Clémence and Didier Krzentowski. It produces contemporary furniture and objects with designers such as Konstantin Grcic, Jasper Morrison and Hella Jongerius, and it also shows French and Italian lighting from the 1950s to the 1980s. A second gallery opened in London's Mayfair in 2014.

The contemporary pieces are made in limited series, created by the designers exclusively for the gallery. The Paris gallery has been at 31 rue Dauphine in Saint-Germain-des-Prés since 2008. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.
facts: Limited-series design furniture, objects and vintage lighting

makers:the-conran-shop.name: The Conran Shop
paragraphs: The Conran Shop is a design shop based in London, opened in 1973 on Fulham Road by Sir Terence Conran. It sells furniture, lighting, kitchen and dining items, rugs, cushions and gifts, including work by outside designers it collaborates with, such as the Pieces by Charlie Sheppard collection.

Alongside that range, the shop sells exclusive designs drawn in-house by its London team, TCS Studio, and made by manufacturers and artisans internationally. It lists the United Kingdom and the Middle East as its markets. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.
facts: Furniture, lighting, home accessories and gifts

makers:eric-schmitt-studio.name: Eric Schmitt Studio
paragraphs: Eric Schmitt is a self-taught designer and craftsman whose design office and workshop sit on the edge of the Fontainebleau forest in France. He makes furniture, lighting, vases and objects, along with a jewellery line, working in hammered wrought iron, bronze and marble. His first pieces were hand-forged with a power hammer.

A design starts as a drawing that becomes a model, which founders, glassmakers and marble workers produce. The parts return to the atelier to be patinated and assembled. The work is also carried by galleries and editors including Galerie Dutko, Maison Liaigre and Carpenters Workshop Gallery. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.
facts: Furniture, lighting, vases and objects in metal and stone

makers:paradisverkstaden.name: Paradisverkstaden
paragraphs: Paradisverkstaden is a family-run ceramics workshop and shop in Färjestaden on Öland, Sweden, making handmade ceramics there since 1974. The range covers tableware, candle holders, vases and planters, with stoneware used for the Lantliv series and glazes in oat, brown and natural tones.

Pieces are thrown by hand in the workshop, and some are decorated with hand-painted stripes. The business also runs a café and an art hall, and has made a collection with Ovland. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.
facts: Handmade ceramics: tableware, candle holders, vases, pots

makers:de-la-espada.name: De La Espada
paragraphs: De La Espada is a furniture maker founded in 1993 by Fatima De La Espada and Luis De Oliveira, with its main workshop in Mira on Portugal's Silver Coast. It makes beds, tables, chairs, sofas, desks and storage in solid wood and upholstery, and uses Manta Lido, a hand-woven merino wool textile from the Alentejo region.

Furniture is built to order by craftspeople, designers and product engineers who share one workshop. Designs come from its in-house De La Espada Atelier and from outside designers such as Neri&Hu, Luca Nichetto and Sam Baron. It also runs a gallery in Porto. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.
facts: Furniture in solid wood and upholstery

makers:rihouse.name: Rihouse
paragraphs: Rihouse is a design space and online shop in Barcelona, Spain, linked to the studio of designer Francesc Rifé. It is a retailer: it sells furniture, lighting, objects and books, including pieces the studio designed for other brands, so it does not make all of them itself. It also offers the RI Collection, a furniture line that revives designs from the studio.

The physical space at Josep Bertrand 3 has two levels, an open showroom and a quieter lower floor. It works with artists, emerging designers and contemporary artisans, and the RI Collection includes new made-to-measure furniture. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:magis.name: Magis
paragraphs: Magis is an Italian furniture company founded in 1976 by Eugenio Perazza and based in Torre di Mosto, in the Veneto region. It makes chairs, stools, tables, sofas, storage, lighting and outdoor furniture. Its catalogue includes Konstantin Grcic's Chair_One, a die-cast aluminium chair from 2003, and Jasper Morrison's Air-Chair, a polypropylene chair made with air-moulding.

Magis works with outside designers, among them Jasper Morrison, Konstantin Grcic and Naoto Fukasawa, and chooses materials and production methods project by project. Logistics, assembly, offices and a showroom share one site in Torre di Mosto, in use since 2010. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:audo.name: Audo
paragraphs: Audo Copenhagen is a Danish design company in Copenhagen that sells furniture, lighting and accessories. Its collections include Eave, Plinth, Hashira, Androgyne and Harbour, developed with outside designers such as Norm Architects, Krøyer Sætter-Lassen, Colin King and Danielle Siggerud.

Since 2019 the company has been based at Audo House, a revived historic building that combines a café and restaurant, a concept shop, its headquarters and guest residences. It also offers a B2B order portal and an upholstery programme for professionals. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:asplund.name: Asplund
paragraphs: Asplund is a design retailer in Stockholm, Sweden, founded in 1990, with a store and showroom on Sibyllegatan and a webshop. It sells its own ASPLUND Collection of furniture and rugs alongside lighting, textiles and objects from other brands, so not everything it sells is made by Asplund. Its rugs include hand-knotted, hand-tufted, handloom and handwoven types, among them an art rug collection made with Åman.

The Stockholm store, the webshop and selected retailers carry the collection, and ASPLUND Studio offers interior design consulting for homes. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:dcw-editions.name: DCW éditions
paragraphs: DCW éditions is a French publisher of objects, mainly lighting, with a showroom in Paris that is open by appointment. Its range covers pendant, table, floor and wall lights from designers such as Marc Held, Bernard Schottlander and Gaëlle Lauriot-Prévost & Dominique Perrault. Since 2019 it has worked with the French electrical fittings maker MODELEC, which produces its switches.

DCW also offers a made-to-order service for residential, hospitality and office projects, available on certain models from existing collections such as Lampe Gras, Mantis and In the Sun, subject to minimum order quantities. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:maruni.name: Maruni
paragraphs: Maruni is a wood furniture maker in Hiroshima, Japan, founded in 1928 as Showa Bentwood Factory and renamed Maruni Wood Industry in 1933. It makes chairs, sofas, stools and tables, including the Hiroshima series developed under art director Naoto Fukasawa, which has a natural wood finish with almost no paint or varnish.

Maruni works with outside designers: Fukasawa has been art director since 2010, Jasper Morrison joined in 2011 and Cecilie Manz in 2022. The factory is in Hiroshima prefecture and showrooms are in Tokyo, Osaka, Hiroshima, Hatsukaichi and Fukuoka. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:dusty-deco.name: Dusty Deco
paragraphs: Dusty Deco is a Swedish interior brand with a flagship store at Storgatan 1 in Stockholm and showrooms in Los Angeles and Palma de Mallorca. Edin and Lina Kjellvertz, who began in fashion, started it as a selection of furniture, objects and art bought on trips that began in the USA. It now also designs its own collection, and has released one with Matthew Williamson.

The founders lead design on the signature collections across furniture, rugs, lighting and objects. The shop also offers an interior design service and a trade section for professionals. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:atelier-areti.name: Atelier Areti
paragraphs: Atelier Areti is a design and manufacturing studio for lighting and furniture, founded in 2008 by Gwendolyn and Guillane Kerschbaumer, with bases in the UK and Germany. Its workshop is in the Sauerland region of Germany and works mainly with metal, glass, stone and wood. Each light in the Disc and Sphere Glass series has a handmade glass disc with its own pattern.

The studio offers customisations and bespoke pieces, including single pieces and small series, with designers, architects, lighting technicians and craftspeople following each project from concept to delivery. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:moustache.name: Moustache
paragraphs: Moustache is a French design publisher based in Paris, launched in April 2009 by Stéphane Arriubergé and Massimiliano Iorio. It publishes furniture, lighting and objects designed by others, including Inga Sempé, Constance Guisset and Big-Game. Some of its objects are in the permanent collections of MoMA in New York and the Musée des Arts Décoratifs in Paris.
Moustache commissions pieces from designers and produces the collection in Europe, and ships worldwide. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:ingo-maurer.name: Ingo Maurer
paragraphs: Ingo Maurer is a lighting design company in Munich, Germany, built around the lamps, lighting systems and objects Ingo Maurer began designing in the mid-1960s. It has worked from Schwabing since 1970, and its range includes the YaYaHo low-voltage system from 1984. Production in Munich is manual, using craft suppliers, often from the Munich region.

Alongside regular products, a projects department handles lighting commissions and interior light planning, and showrooms operate in Munich, New York and Milan. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:gatomikio.name: GATOMIKIO
paragraphs: GATOMIKIO is a Japanese lacquerware maker based in Yamanaka Onsen, operated by GATO MIKIO – SHOUTEN Co., Ltd. It makes lacquered wooden tableware such as bowls, plates, cups and tea caddies, grouped into collections including TURARI, AEKA, TSUMUGI and TOHKA, and draws on traditional Yamanaka lacquerware techniques.

The affiliated GATOMIKIO/1 project aims to return to the basics of Yamanaka lacquerware, and individual pieces are credited to named designers, among them Lars Vejen for the SAIBI Wooden Bowl. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:b-b-italia.name: B&B Italia
paragraphs: B&B Italia is an Italian furniture maker founded in 1966 as C&B, a joint venture between Cassina and Busnelli started by Piero Ambrogio Busnelli. It makes indoor and outdoor sofas, armchairs, tables, beds and storage, and brought cold-moulded polyurethane foam to upholstered furniture, as in Gaetano Pesce's UP series of 1969.

Designers working with the company include Antonio Citterio, Piero Lissoni, Patricia Urquiola and Vincent Van Duysen. Fabrics, leathers and finishes can be customised on request, and the furniture is sold through B&B Italia stores and authorised dealers. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:tiptoe.name: Tiptoe
paragraphs: Tiptoe is a French furniture design studio founded in 2015, with a showroom in Paris. It designs tables, wall shelves, chairs, sofas, lamps and outdoor furniture, including the UNIT storage system, which customers can configure online.

Production is in Europe with partners working in wood, metal and recycled plastic, including a family metalworking firm in Haute-Savoie. Tiptoe is a B Corp certified company and sells through its own shop and a network of resellers. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:catellani-smith.name: Catellani & Smith
paragraphs: Catellani & Smith is an Italian lighting maker founded in 1989 by Enzo Catellani in Villa di Serio, in the province of Bergamo. It produces suspension, ceiling, wall, table and floor lamps, built by hand from materials including aluminium wire, fibreglass, crystal, glass and gold or silver leaf.

Many pieces have been made to size or to a client's brief, for example a two-metre Fil de Fer lamp for the Victoria & Albert Museum café. Newer models use LEDs. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:dooq.name: Dooq
paragraphs: Dooq is a design company in Lisbon, Portugal, making furniture and lighting: lounge, modular and dining seating, tables, storage, lamps and outdoor pieces. Its Mosaico collection, designed by Studiopepe, is a modular system of 26 linear and curved modules with wooden joinery and upholstered volumes.

The company combines Portuguese craftsmanship with the work of designers, and pairs softer materials such as velvet and straw with harder ones such as brass, marble and wood. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:miniforms.name: Miniforms
paragraphs: Miniforms is an Italian furniture company based in Meolo, north of Venice. It makes tables, seating, padded furniture, storage, coffee tables, lighting and accessories for homes, hospitality and offices. Luigi Bardini started the business in wooden furniture, and his sons took it over in 2009.

Production relies on craft trades including carpenters, glassblowers, ceramic shapers and upholsterers, with machines assisting the hand work. Since 2009 the company has chosen young designers and moved towards rounder, more colourful shapes. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:ay-illuminate.name: AY Illuminate
paragraphs: Ay Illuminate is a lighting company based in Amersfoort, the Netherlands. Its core line, Authentics, is lighting that shapes naturally occurring structures, forms and materials, including waste materials, into new forms.

The Authentics are manufactured by artisans with specialised skills in Asia, Africa and Europe, in ongoing cooperation with the company. It works with distributors in several regions, including Italy, Mexico and New Zealand. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:gubi.name: Gubi
paragraphs: Gubi is a design house in Copenhagen, Denmark, offering furniture, lighting and interior objects, from 20th-century designs to work by current designers. The range covers seating, tables, lighting, outdoor furniture and accessories, with designers such as Gamfratesi, Greta M. Grossman and Space Copenhagen.

Gubi works with specialist manufacturers around the world to produce its pieces, and sells through its webshop and retail partners. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:tamo.name: Tamo
paragraphs: TAMO is a Polish furniture and home accessories brand with its studio in Gdynia, Poland. It offers chairs, sofas, tables, storage, beds and lighting in named series such as Arche, Aura and Undia, and it publishes a making-of story for its Arche chair.

The furniture is made in Poland in family-run workshops, using materials such as solid wood, natural stone, glass, wool and aluminium. The brand also works with outside designers and galleries on collaboration pieces. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:bd-barcelona.name: BD Barcelona
paragraphs: BD Barcelona is a furniture design company based in Barcelona, Spain, founded in 1972 by a group of young architects and designers that included Oscar Tusquets. It produces and markets its own designs and those of other designers, from an Antoni Gaudí collection to the modular Rasters cabinet system.

The catalogue covers chairs, sofas, cabinets, coffee tables and candleholders, with contemporary designers such as Jaime Hayon, Konstantin Grcic and Sabine Marcelis alongside historic names. The company is under collective ownership. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:norr11.name: NORR11
paragraphs: NORR11 is a Danish furniture and lighting company with its showroom and headquarters in Copenhagen, founded in 2011. The range covers chairs, sofas, tables, lighting and outdoor pieces in collections such as Hippo, Langue and Elephant, and a sofa configurator lets buyers build a sofa and request a quote.

Designs come from an in-house studio led by founder Tommy Hyldahl and lead designer Kristian Sofus Hansen. The pieces are sold through resellers in many countries, and professionals can use a Quick Ship programme. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:moebe.name: Moebe
paragraphs: MOEBE is a Danish design studio in Copenhagen, formed in 2014 by architects Martin de Neergard Christensen and Nicholas Oldroyd together with cabinet maker Anders Thams. It makes modular furniture, lighting and everyday objects, including a Shelving System with solid oak wedges that is produced in Lithuania.

Customers can plan a shelving layout in an online configurator and view it in augmented reality. The brand sells directly online and through retailers, offers spare parts, and gives a five-year warranty on its designs. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:rubn.name: Rubn
paragraphs: Rubn is a Swedish lighting maker with its address in Malmö and its factory in Vittsjö. It makes table, ceiling, floor and wall lamps, a bathroom collection and candle holders, organised in named families such as Angel, Bloomsbury and Kennedy. The brand states that 98 percent of its products are made in-house in Sweden.

Rubn is run as a family business, and the lamps are made by its own craftspeople. Besides the standard range it offers bespoke lighting projects for professionals. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:design-house-stockholm.name: Design House Stockholm
paragraphs: Design House Stockholm is a Swedish design brand based in Stockholm, with a flagship store in the city. It publishes furniture, lighting, tableware, textiles and decor by many designers, including Harri Koskinen's Block Lamp, Eva Schildt's Gardener's Sofa and Karl Malmvall's Step stepladder.

The company works like a publisher: designers, known or unknown, send in ideas, and some are chosen for development and production. It sells directly online and through resellers. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:marset.name: Marset
paragraphs: Marset is a lighting company with its headquarters and factory in Terrassa, Barcelona, Spain. It makes indoor and outdoor lighting, from pendant, floor, table and wall lamps to bollards and lampposts, and works with outside designers, for example Joan Gaspar on the Ringo and Fris lamps.

The collection is built around soft light that does not dazzle. Marset sells through retailers, an online store and a trade programme, and supplies lighting for hotels, restaurants, offices and homes. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:desalto.name: Desalto
paragraphs: Desalto is an Italian furniture company based in Cantù, in the Brianza region. It makes tables, seating, upholstered pieces, side tables, consoles and outdoor furniture, with metal as its original specialty. The business grew out of the Orsenigo family's metal workshop ORMA, started in 1963, and took its present direction in 1990.

Desalto develops its collections together with designers and manufactures at its headquarters in Cantù, combining craft with industrial precision. The site also offers a configurator. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:raawii.name: Raawii
paragraphs: Raawii is a design company in Copenhagen, Denmark, founded in 2017 by Bo Raahauge Rasmussen and Nicholai Wiig-Hansen. It offers furniture, lighting, tableware, mirrors, wall clocks and blankets, developed with a roster of designers that includes Erwan Bouroullec and Michael Kvium. The Jam centrepiece, a black piece by Kvium, is released as a limited edition.

The collections are built around collaborations with outside designers, and the company aims for production that respects people and gives designers good working conditions. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:workstead.name: Workstead
paragraphs: Workstead is a design studio in Brooklyn, New York, founded in 2009 by Robert Highsmith and Stefanie Brechbuehler. It designs buildings and interiors for hospitality, residential and commercial clients, and also develops its own line of lighting, with a lighting studio in Charleston, South Carolina. The lighting is crafted in the Appalachian Mountains of Virginia.

The lighting range covers ceiling, wall, floor, table, flush mount and outdoor fixtures, sold as in-stock, quick-ship and custom pieces. The studio also has a branded partnership with Schumacher. On Formground it is shown through {count} pieces, each linked to its own page.

makers:form-refine.name: Form & Refine
paragraphs: Form & Refine is a Danish design brand founded in 2018 by Helle Herman Mortensen, Jonas Herman Pedersen and Lasse Lund Lauridsen. It offers furniture for small living across seating, tables, storage and shelving, lighting and objects, including the Taper Console & Shoe Rack and the A Line Storage Bench collection.
